# Crisp Video

> Crisp Video restores, denoises and upscales old, low-res video to 4K offline on a Mac or a Windows PC, then lets you edit it on a real timeline. Free to use: upscaling, restoring and colour exports up to 15 seconds, everything else at full length, video and GIF exports with a small “crispvideo.app” mark. Black Friday sale: $9.99 once, 31% off our November price of $14.50, through December 2. Then $19. No subscription. Mac: macOS 14.0 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Windows: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, with graphics that support Vulkan (most PCs from 2016 on have them).

## Product and pricing

Pro: Black Friday sale: $9.99 once, 31% off our November price of $14.50, through December 2. Then $19. ## How-to guides
- [How-to guides for video on a Mac](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/): every guide, by task
- [How to restore old film footage on a Mac: dust, flicker](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/restore-old-film-footage-mac/): Clean up an old film or video transfer on a Mac: remove single-frame dust and blotches, steady the brightness flicker, and upscale.
- [Fix blurry or pixelated video on a Mac: what works](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/fix-pixelated-video-mac/): Fix pixelated or blurry video on a Mac: it is missing detail, so no setting turns it off.
- [Upscale video on a Mac, 480p to 1080p or 4K: free](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-video-on-mac/): Upscale video on a Mac, from 480p to 1080p or 4K: free, offline, no upload.
- [How to upscale a finished edit to 4K on a Mac: offline](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-a-finished-edit-to-4k-mac/): Edit your video on a timeline and upscale the whole finished cut to 4K in one export with Crisp, Enhance or the generative Max model, 100% offline.
- [How to batch upscale videos on a Mac (2026)](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/batch-upscale-videos-mac/): Batch upscale videos on a Mac: test on one clip first, avoid filename collisions, and know why a big queue takes as long as it does.
- [Stabilize shaky video on a Mac: the best free option](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/stabilize-shaky-video-mac/): Stabilize shaky video on a Mac and pick the best stabilizer: what software can and cannot fix, what it costs in framing, jello, and the free ffmpeg option.
- [Deinterlace video on a Mac, and what interlacing is](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/deinterlace-video-mac/): Deinterlace video on a Mac, and what interlacing is: how to tell comb teeth from look-alikes, the ffmpeg check, and why a file's flag can lie after re-encoding.
- [How to compress a video on a Mac: free, offline, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/compress-video-on-mac/): Compress a video on a Mac to shrink the file for email or upload, in one tap.
- [How to convert MOV to MP4 on a Mac (2026): free, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/convert-mov-to-mp4-mac/): Convert MOV to MP4 on a Mac in one tap, 100% offline, usually losslessly with Pro.
